Fenix Flexin Shows Love To Late San Francisco Artist Ksmigz When Mentioning NorCal Artists

“The homie Ksmigz, rest in peace” 🕊️💯 

@fenixflexinofficial @ksmigz
🎥 @foocommunity 

Ksmigz, Born Kieran Carlson, Was A Rising San Francisco Rapper Who Was Known For His Raw Street-Oriented Sound And Strong Ties To The City’s Excelsior Neighborhood. The Young Bay Area Artist Was Building A Name For Himself In The Underground Rap Scene Before Tragically Losing His Life On April 3, 2022, At Just 20 Years Old. His Music And Legacy Continue To Live On Through His Friends, Family, And Supporters. 🕊️💔 IMDb +1

Shoreline Mafia’s Fenix Flexin Recently Paid Tribute To The Late San Francisco Artist During An Interview With Foo Community, Saying, “The Homie Ksmigz, Rest In Peace.” The Shoutout Shows That Ksmigz’s Name Continues To Be Remembered Beyond The Bay Area. 🙏

Now, More Than Four Years After His Passing, Ksmigz’s Team Has Released The Posthumous Deluxe Edition Of “Long Live 52” On November 6, 2026, Continuing To Keep His Music And Legacy Alive. The Project Features Songs Including “All Facts,” “No Sleep,” “Back 2 Back,” And “Long Live 52, Pt. 2,” Giving Fans Another Opportunity To Celebrate The Late Artist’s Talent And Impact. LONG LIVE KSMIGZ! 🕊️❤️‍🩹🎶 Amazon Music +1
